en: A black and white photograph showing a historical street parade or religious procession. The participants are dressed in period costumes, some resembling Roman soldiers and others in robes, reenacting a biblical scene (likely the Passion of Christ, with a central figure carrying a cross). Crowds line both sides of a bustling city street, and there are many flags hanging from the buildings. In the background, a tall, recognizable medieval bell tower rises above the rooftops.
